attchmntText: Shalibhadra Finance Limited has informed the Exchange about related Party Transactions
voiceSummary: Shalibhadra Finance Limited filed disclosures of related party transactions for the half year ended 30th September 2026. Key Management Personnel include Vatsal M. Doshi, Minesh M. Doshi, Ayushi M. Doshi, Dhruvil M. Doshi, Kamalkant Keswani, Govind Keswani, and Megha Singh. Transactions during the period include remuneration of 12.00 Lakhs for Vatsal M. Doshi and 6.00 Lakhs for Dhruvil M. Doshi. Rent payments of 0.54 Lakhs were made to both Vatsal M. Doshi and Dhruvil M. Doshi. Rent deposits of 25.00 Lakhs and 50.00 Lakhs were paid to Vatsal M. Doshi and Dhruvil M. Doshi respectively. Interest payments were made to various relatives and entities, including 1.76 Lakhs to Minesh M. Doshi. Financial Analysts & Investment Rating Ltd received a loan of 1036.07 Lakhs, interest received of 74.24 Lakhs, rent of 0.84 Lakhs, and a rent deposit of 62.00 Lakhs. The filing was signed by Managing Director Vatsal Doshi, DIN 07950770.

attchmntText: Shalibhadra Finance Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Shalibhadra Finance Limited approved un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, during a board meeting on November 14, 2026. Net profit for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, was Rs. 508 lakh, compared to Rs. 491 lakh in the same period last year. Earnings per share stood at Rs. 1.64. Total revenue from operations for the quarter was Rs. 1,133 lakh. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, net profit was Rs. 999 lakh, with total revenue from operations at Rs. 2,242 lakh. The company reported total assets of Rs. 26,855 lakh as of September 30, 2026. Paid-up equity share capital remained at Rs. 3,089 lakh. The statutory auditors, M/s Vora & Associates, issued a limited review report. Disclosures regarding the utilization of issue proceeds for private placement non-convertible debentures were also submitted.

attchmntText: Shalibhadra Finance Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated October 29, 2026, titled "Shalibhadra Finance reduces Incremental Cost of Borrowing".
